Here are the modified [run](https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/ian/4_layer_run_prefill.sh) and [compare ](https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/ian/compare_results.py) scripts for what I am running the new mlir with
This looks to be an issue in the runtime circular buffer when loading the irpa params, and fixed with https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/21758

issue.body:
### What happened?

We are still seeing non-deterministic results in Llama 405b when exporting 4 attention layers with using the `--iree-llvmgpu-set-workgroup-distribution-along=z` flag. I was able to narrow down where the non-determinism in the model is coming from. When I try to save the output of the util.global.load of `@"__auto.blk.2.ffn_down.weight:qs"` and run it multiple times, the output sometimes is deterministic, but sometimes is non-deterministic.

The weird thing is when I tried to make a very small repro of the util.global.load of `@"__auto.blk.2.ffn_down.weight:qs"`, it is always deterministic, but returning the util.global.load in the 4 attention layer IR, I see the non-determinism sometimes.

### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Download 4_layer_non_determinism.mlir:
```
wget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/aviator19941/c5167a2cd7733344051bd7a0a9187005/raw/90805c29c212944d53676232b60f788110e8af9b/4_layer_non_determinism.mlir
```
2. Download compile, run, and compare scripts and inputs:
```
wget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/aviator19941/ed166bfcd02fdf4cf7a53bc04b2be87e/raw/67d78387ebe0f1c8884015ae040312ea1b9abd11/4_layer_compile.sh
wget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/aviator19941/6c6c0d3c16f8315dca0e16585f290f41/raw/48babe061457d3aeed26d48cf687aebf88e1868a/4_layer_run_prefill.sh
wget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/aviator19941/fc5d72e5be2761b27c5ae667db94953e/raw/3c61f21861922778f827fd0ab17ef9c13ff5f9ca/compare_results.py
wget https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/halo-models/llm-dev/llama3_405b/fp4/inputs/prefill_1/tokens.npy
wget https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/halo-models/llm-dev/llama3_405b/fp4/inputs/prefill_1/seq_lens.npy
wget https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/halo-models/llm-dev/llama3_405b/fp4/inputs/prefill_1/seq_block_ids.npy
wget https://sharkpublic.blob.core.windows.net/sharkpublic/halo-models/llm-dev/llama3_405b/fp4/inputs/prefill_1/cache.npy
```
3. Setup venv:
```
python3.11 -m venv .test
source .test/bin/activate
pip install -f https://iree.dev/pip-release-links.html --upgrade --pre \
  iree-turbine
```
4. Run scripts:
```
./4_layer_compile.sh && ./4_layer_run_prefill.sh && python compare_results.py
```

### What component(s) does this issue relate to?

_No response_

### Version information

68a9971c0bea8e3fcbf09bea4376659d91012db1

### Additional context

_No response_
